hook: Claude just solved two open black hole problems.
hookText: Claude solved two black hole problems

beats.say: Anthropic says Claude completed a calculation physicists set up more than twenty years ago but never solved.
It showed the sudden transition linked to black hole formation, a phase transition Hawking and Page described in 1983, persists even where spacetime has no definite shape.
Second, it found the exact limit of the simplest version of a technique used to test theories of quantum gravity.
